name: Moonmilk
author: E. T. Carter
description: A still pool deep in a limestone cave: lumpy, milky dripstones hang from a violet-shadowed vault, their thin tips glowing teal, and a cluster of stalagmites stands round a spring on the right that lights them from below. The black water mirrors them all; drip rings spread across it, low mist creeps over it and gold and teal motes rise and fade.

params.label: Pool glow
params.effect: How strongly the water glows and lights the dripstones from below.

params.label: Merge
params.effect: How far the dripstones weld into each other and the roof, from sharp separate spikes to melted flowstone.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the mist, the rising motes, the drip rings and the breathing of the glow.
